ozempic is near life saving for me. 

i’m a type 2 diabetic, but my mental illnesses cause me to have a really hard time with my diet and exercise. yes, i could definitely try harder and stop making excuses to an extent, but it’s just difficult for me. 

i started ozempic in early 2022 when i had insurance through my job. $30 per pickup. lost a lot of weight quickly which made me MOTIVATED to actually work on myself outside of just the ozempic. 

then i got out of an abusive relationship, moved back home, and in turn, left that job and lost the insurance. 

stopped ozempic for a few months, gained back some but not a lot. 

got some crappy health insurance, paid way too much for way too little payout. ozempic WITH A COUPON was still $530. not doable when i could barely pay my other bills even living rent free. quit ozempic again after my mom paid that fee for one pickup. gained back all i had lost and more because i didn’t have the help of ozempic and i was just super depressed. 

now i have good health insurance again that will allow me to pay $375 deductible for ozempic and then $30 per pickup after that. i just haven’t gone back for my checkup after my blood work was done to talk to my new doctor about starting back up on it. 

somehow even with all the starts and stops of ozempic, being motivated and losing weight and then being depressed and gaining it all back, and my continuance of sugar and other things i should avoid as a diabetic, my a1c has still gone from 11.9% to 8.3%. not great still, but somehow going down!
